commentary.text: 90+1' Cesar Soto Grado is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' We will have 1 min. of added time.
90' The corner is swung in but Valladolid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' A pass by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
83' Here comes a substitution. Renato Tapia is given a rest as he is replaced by Julian Chicco (Leganes).
82' Adrian Arnuncio (Valladolid) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
75' Borja Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) replacing Dani Raba.
74' Today's match ends for Seydouba Cisse who will be replaced by Darko Brasanac (Leganes).
72' A substitution has been made. Mamadou Sylla is replaced by Adrian Arnuncio (Valladolid).
72' Here is a change. Juanmi Latasa is going off and Alvaro Rubio gives the last tactical orders to Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid).
71' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
70' The ball possession at the moment is 56:44.
63' Substitution. Duk (Leganes) has come on for Yan Diomande.
63' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Munir El Haddadi will be replaced by Diego Garcia (Leganes).
62' Yan Diomande (Leganes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
60' Yan Diomande (Leganes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
60' The resulting corner from Raul Moro (Valladolid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
59' Raul Moro (Valladolid) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Now Valladolid have a corner.
57' Wonderful movement by Valladolid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
51' Dani Raba (Leganes) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
51' The resulting set piece from Leganes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

50' Dani Raba (Leganes) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Karl Hein, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Leganes.
47' Mario Maroto (Valladolid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
46' Alvaro Rubio has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Cenk Ozkacar comes on the pitch for Joseph Aidoo (Valladolid).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Alvaro Rubio probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Antonio Candela (Valladolid). He is replaced by Luis Perez.
46' Half-time substitution. Alvaro Rubio decided to make a change. Anuar (Valladolid) is replaced by Mario Maroto.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
45+3' Valladolid are awarded a free kick from long range.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
40' 3 - 0 Goal! Juan Cruz (Leganes) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 3:0.
38' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid).

36' 2 - 0 Seydouba Cisse is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Yan Diomande (Leganes) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom right corner to make the score 2:0.
34' The Leganes players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Cesar Soto Grado signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.

33' GOAL! Superb work from Munir El Haddadi, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Seydouba Cisse (Leganes), who beats Karl Hein with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
32' Joseph Aidoo (Valladolid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
30' Antonio Candela (Valladolid) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
30' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Cesar Soto Grado saw the whole situation.
29' Raul Moro (Valladolid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marko Dmitrovic, who smothers the ball.
26' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
24' 1 - 0 Goal! Great play by Yan Diomande releases Javi Hernandez (Leganes) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top right corner. 1:0.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valladolid.

22' Anuar (Valladolid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valladolid.
22' Adria Altimira (Leganes) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar.
21' The resulting corner, taken by Dani Raba (Leganes), comes to nothing.
21' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Leganes for a penalty. Play continues.

20' Dani Raba (Leganes) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Karl Hein pulls off an easy save.
18' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Dani Raba (Leganes) sends it out of play.
18' Adria Altimira (Leganes) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Leganes win a corner.
16' The foul by Dani Raba (Leganes) was seen by Cesar Soto Grado who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
13' Cesar Soto Grado shows the yellow card to Antonio Candela (Valladolid) for a heavy challenge.
12' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.

12' Raul Moro (Valladolid) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Marko Dmitrovic!
10' Some neat passing and movement from Leganes as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

7' Yan Diomande (Leganes) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.

6' Dani Raba (Leganes) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
3' Wasted opportunity! Ibrahim Alani (Valladolid) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.

2' Great chance! Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
1' Henrique (Valladolid) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Cesar Soto Grado.
